      "question": "最终回复是否同时正确给出 CRM 成交金额、Q1 原始过账、Q2 更正的有符号金额以及两条凭证有符号相加后的净额？",
      "pass_anchor": "真实 NetSuite 链路：OPP-COHORT-1001 对应 CRM 金额为 1,100,000 美分；JL-REV-240118 在 FY2024-Q1 原始过账为 +1,000,000 美分；JL-REV-240219 在 FY2024-Q2 更正过账为 -200,000 美分；两条 POSTED 行按有符号金额相加净额为 800,000 美分。允许用美元等价表达，但必须保留正负方向和净额含义，不能把 -200,000 写成正数或把绝对值相加。"
    },
    {

      "question": "最终回复是否识别两个财务客户名称是同一 account_spine/客户主键下的名称变体，而不是两个不同客户？",
      "pass_anchor": "真实 customer_ledger_dim：LED-CUST-24031 的 legal_name 为 Acme Inc.，LED-CUST-24032 的 legal_name 为 Acme, Inc；两行都映射到 account_id SF-AC-0700，且均为 Active、USD Corporation。答案应明确按共同客户主键归一，并指出名称标点差异不构成两个客户。"
    },

      "pass_anchor": "真实对账记录 RECON-24017 的 reason_code 为 CROSS_PERIOD、原始对账差异为 -100,000 美分且原状态为 UNRESOLVED；同一 cohort 的 Q2 负数更正行使净额变为 800,000 美分，但不能据此把 CRM 1,100,000 美分与跨期总账确认自动视为已完成。答案应把跨期间/更正/尚未完成复核与 IN_REVIEW 处置联系起来。"

      "id": "source_reports_unchanged",

  "check_code": "\"\"\"Task-specific deterministic checks for the NetSuite mutation and memo artifact.\"\"\"\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport hashlib\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\n\nTARGET_RECON = \"RECON-24017\"\nTARGET_MEMO = \"03_诊断报告/MavenTech跨期间收入复核备忘录.docx\"\nSOURCE_HASHES = {\n    \"03_诊断报告/MavenTech漏斗指标口径与局限说明.docx\": \"6047e5b31fd7cccde5fd7a10df67028b8be50f959d5ae67bfaf6096762d1240d\",\n    \"03_诊断报告/MavenTech漏斗诊断评审纪要_2018-01-12.docx\": \"6ed986fb0b23664a65036faa8456cdcb651977a10ef76ac53152a7a55ec29724\",\n}\n\ndef _db(ws):\n    return Path(ws).parent / \"system\" / \"netsuite_financials\" / \"state.db\"\n\ndef _norm(value):\n    return re.sub(r\"[\\s，,。；;：:（）()\\[\\]{}\\\"'`]+\", \"\", str(value or \"\")).lower()\n\ndef _doc_text(path):\n    from docx import Document\n    doc = Document(str(path))\n    chunks = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs]\n    for table in doc.tables:\n        chunks.extend(cell.text for row in table.rows for cell in row.cells)\n    return \"\\n\".join(chunks)\n\ndef recon_status(ws):\n    with sqlite3.connect(_db(ws)) as con:\n        row = con.execute(\"SELECT resolution_status, resolution_note FROM crm_revenue_reconciliation WHERE recon_id=?\", (TARGET_RECON,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"target reconciliation not found\"}\n    status, note = row\n    note_text = _norm(note)\n    has_timing = any(token in note_text for token in (\"跨期间\", \"跨期\", \"crossperiod\", \"timing\"))\n    has_pending = any(token in note_text for token in (\"尚未完成\", \"待复核\", \"未完成\", \"未解决\", \"继续复核\", \"inreview\", \"review\"))\n    ok = status == \"IN_REVIEW\" and has_timing and has_pending\n    return {\"score\": int(ok), \"detail\": f\"status={status!r}, note={note!r}\"}\n\ndef memo_written(ws):\n    path = Path(ws) / TARGET_MEMO\n    if not path.exists() or path.suffix.lower() != \".docx\":\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"missing {TARGET_MEMO}\"}\n    try:\n        text = _doc_text(path)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"cannot read memo: {exc}\"}\n    compact = _norm(text)\n    required = [\"1100000\", \"1000000\", \"800000\", \"recon-24017\", \"opp-cohort-1001\", \"fy2024-q1\", \"fy2024-q2\", \"sf-ac-0700\", \"in_review\"]\n    missing = [value for value in required if _norm(value) not in compact]\n    # Accept the same signed correction expressed in cents or in dollars.\n    signed_correction_ok = \"-200000\" in compact or bool(re.search(r\"-\\s*(?:usd|\\$)?\\s*2,?000(?:\\b|[^\\d])\", text, re.IGNORECASE))\n    if not signed_correction_ok:\n        missing.append(\"-200000 or -USD 2,000\")\n    # Keep the comma-bearing legal-name variant check separate because _norm removes punctuation.\n    name_ok = \"acmeinc\" in compact and \"acme,inc\" in text.lower().replace(\" \", \"\")\n    if not name_ok:\n        missing.append(\"Acme, Inc\")\n    return {\"score\": int(not missing), \"detail\": \"missing facts: \" + \", \".join(missing) if missing else \"memo facts found\"}\n\ndef protected_records_unchanged(ws):\n    current = _db(ws)\n    expected = {\n        (\"crm_revenue_reconciliation\", \"recon_id\", \"RECON-24019\"): (\"RECON-24019\", \"JL-REV-240219\", \"OPP-COHORT-1001\", 0, -200000, -200000, \"CORRECTION\", \"RESOLVED\", \"Correction journal reverses overstatement from original posting\"),\n        (\"revenue_journal_line\", \"journal_line_id\", \"JL-REV-240118\"): (\"JL-REV-240118\", \"PER-24Q1-017\", \"LED-CUST-24031\", \"OPP-COHORT-1001\", 1000000, \"POSTED\", 0, \"INV-2401-8842\", \"2024-03-29\"),\n        (\"revenue_journal_line\", \"journal_line_id\", \"JL-REV-240219\"): (\"JL-REV-240219\", \"PER-24Q2-026\", \"LED-CUST-24032\", \"OPP-COHORT-1001\", -200000, \"POSTED\", 1, \"ADJ-2404-0197\", \"2024-04-08\"),\n        (\"customer_ledger_dim\", \"ledger_customer_id\", \"LED-CUST-24031\"): (\"LED-CUST-24031\", \"SF-AC-0700\", \"Acme Inc.\", \"USD\", \"Corporation\", \"Active\"),\n        (\"customer_ledger_dim\", \"ledger_customer_id\", \"LED-CUST-24032\"): (\"LED-CUST-24032\", \"SF-AC-0700\", \"Acme, Inc\", \"USD\", \"Corporation\", \"Active\"),\n    }\n    with sqlite3.connect(current) as con:\n        for (table, key_col, key), wanted in expected.items():\n            row = con.execute(f\"SELECT * FROM {table} WHERE {key_col}=?\", (key,)).fetchone()\n            if row is None or tuple(row) != wanted:\n                return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"protected record changed or missing: {table}/{key}\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"protected NetSuite records unchanged\"}\n\ndef source_reports_unchanged(ws):\n    for relative, expected in SOURCE_HASHES.items():\n        path = Path(ws) / relative\n        if not path.exists():\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"missing protected report: {relative}\"}\n        actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n        if actual != expected:\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"protected report changed: {relative}\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"protected reports unchanged\"}\n",
